title: Data & layout primitives
summary: Tables, lists, grids and blocks for showing real data cleanly, with tabular numbers everywhere.

components.name: Sortable data table
components.summary: Sticky header, sort chevrons with aria-sort, expandable detail rows and tabular numbers.
components.pattern: Table with sortable columns (APG Sortable Table)
called: rows and columns you can sort by clicking the header
table with arrows on column names

anatomy.name: Sorted column
anatomy.text: The arrow shows direction; numbers right-aligned.

anatomy.name: Sticky header
anatomy.text: Stays visible while the body scrolls.

anatomy.name: Row expander
anatomy.text: Opens a detail row below.

anatomy.name: Numeric cell
anatomy.text: Right-aligned, digits lined up.

components.prompt: Add a data table: real <table> with a caption, sticky <th> headers containing sort buttons, aria-sort on the sorted column, numbers right-aligned in tabular figures, expandable detail rows (aria-expanded), and a scrolling wrapper with role="region" tabindex="0" so the page never scrolls sideways.
components.debug: Debug my table. Rule out: divs instead of a table; aria-sort on the button instead of the th; the page scrolling sideways on mobile; numbers left-aligned in proportional figures; sticky headers hidden behind the app header. The symptom:

components.name: Virtualised list
components.summary: Renders only the visible rows of 10,000 so scrolling stays smooth.
called: list with ten thousand rows that stays fast
long list that only renders what you see

anatomy.name: Spacer
anatomy.text: Gives the scrollbar its true length.

anatomy.name: Window
anatomy.text: Only visible rows plus a few above and below.

anatomy.name: Row
anatomy.text: Tells screen readers where it sits in the whole list.

components.prompt: Add a virtualised list: a fixed-height scroll container, a spacer of count × rowHeight, and a window translated to the first visible row that renders only visible rows plus overscan. Keep keyboard navigation with aria-activedescendant and aria-posinset/aria-setsize.
components.debug: Debug my virtual list. Rule out: rows of variable height with a fixed rowHeight; re-rendering on every scroll event without rAF; focus lost when the focused row unmounts; the scrollbar length wrong. The symptom:

components.name: Bento grid
components.summary: Asymmetric feature tiles that collapse to one column on narrow containers.
called: apple style grid of feature boxes
feature grid with one big box

anatomy.name: Wide tile
anatomy.text: The headline feature.

anatomy.name: Tall tile
anatomy.text: A supporting story.

anatomy.name: Small tile
anatomy.text: One fact each.

components.prompt: Add a bento grid: a 3-column grid with one wide and one tall tile, each tile one idea (eyebrow, short heading, one line, a small visual), collapsing to one column when its container is under 620px.
components.debug: Debug my bento grid. Rule out: every tile the same size (that is a card grid); tiles with paragraphs; container queries on the grid itself (style its children); holes from spans on narrow screens. The symptom:

components.name: Scroll-stacking cards
components.summary: Sticky cards that pile on top of each other as you scroll, earlier ones receding.
called: cards that stack as you scroll

anatomy.name: Sticky card
anatomy.text: Each card sticks a little lower than the last.

anatomy.name: Front card
anatomy.text: Cards underneath shrink and dim slightly.

components.prompt: Add scroll-stacking cards: list items with position: sticky and increasing top offsets so they pile up, and buried cards scaled down by a few percent based on how many cards cover them. Plain stacking under reduced motion.
components.debug: Debug my card stack. Rule out: an ancestor with overflow: hidden breaking sticky; cards without solid backgrounds showing through; scale updates on every scroll without rAF. The symptom:

components.name: Comparison table
components.summary: Plan-by-feature matrix with a highlighted column and grouped rows.
called: plans side by side with ticks

anatomy.name: Featured column
anatomy.text: One column tinted, never more.

anatomy.name: Row group
anatomy.text: Groups like Usage and Security.

anatomy.name: Included mark
anatomy.text: A tick for sight, "Included" for screen readers.

components.prompt: Add a comparison table: a real <table> with plans as columns, grouped feature rows (scope="rowgroup"), one featured column tinted, ticks and dashes with visually hidden "Included"/"Not included", and a horizontal scroll container on mobile.
components.debug: Debug my comparison table. Rule out: ticks with no text alternative; the featured column tinted with low-contrast text; the page scrolling sideways on mobile. The symptom:

components.name: Timeline / changelog
components.summary: Dated entries on a quiet rail, the newest marked with the accent.
called: vertical line with dots and dates

anatomy.name: Latest entry
anatomy.text: The newest dot is filled with the accent.

anatomy.name: Date
anatomy.text: Machine-readable date, human label.

components.prompt: Add a timeline: an ordered list where each item has a <time datetime>, a title and a short line; a thin rail with dots; the newest entry marked with the accent and a "Latest" badge.
components.debug: Debug my timeline. Rule out: dates without datetime attributes; the rail misaligned with the dots at different text sizes; reverse order without saying so. The symptom:

components.name: Resizable split pane
components.summary: Two panes and a grip you can drag or move with the arrow keys.

anatomy.name: Grip
anatomy.text: Drag it, or focus it and use the arrow keys.

components.prompt: Add a resizable split pane: two panes with a role="separator" grip (aria-orientation, aria-valuenow/min/max), drag with pointer capture, arrows ±2% and Shift+arrows ±10%, Home/End to limits, double-click to reset.
components.debug: Debug my split pane. Rule out: dragging selecting text (pointer capture and user-select: none); no keyboard path; panes shrinking below usable sizes. The symptom:

components.name: Drag-to-reorder list
components.summary: Reorder rows by dragging a handle or with Space and the arrow keys.
components.pattern: List + live region (keyboard-accessible drag and drop)
called: drag handle with six dots to reorder

anatomy.name: Handle
anatomy.text: Drag it, or press Space, arrows, Space.

anatomy.name: Instructions
anatomy.text: How to move items without a mouse.

components.prompt: Add a reorderable list: a six-dot handle button per row; pointer drag with live reordering; a keyboard alternative (Space to pick up, arrows to move, Space to drop, Esc to cancel); every move announced in an assertive live region.
components.debug: Debug my sortable list. Rule out: no keyboard path; announcements missing; the whole row draggable so text cannot be selected; jank from layout reads during drag. The symptom:

components.name: Code block
components.summary: Monospace code with language tabs, a filename and a copy button.
called: code snippet with a copy button

anatomy.name: Language tabs
anatomy.text: Switch between languages or files.

anatomy.name: Copy
anatomy.text: Copies only the visible panel.

anatomy.name: Code
anatomy.text: Scrolls sideways on its own, never the page.

components.prompt: Add a code block: a <figure> with a caption bar holding language tabs, a filename and a copy button that copies the visible panel; the <pre> scrolls horizontally on its own and is focusable.
components.debug: Debug my code block. Rule out: the page scrolling sideways on long lines; copy grabbing the hidden tab; syntax colours under 4.5:1 in one of the modes. The symptom:

components.name: Stat strip
components.summary: A row of KPIs with tabular values and semantic delta arrows.
called: row of numbers at the top of a dashboard

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.text: Above the number, quiet.

anatomy.name: Value
anatomy.text: Large, tabular.

anatomy.name: Delta
anatomy.api: good or bad, not up or down
anatomy.text: Churn going up is red.

components.prompt: Add a stat strip: a <dl> of 3–5 metrics with labels above large tabular values, deltas coloured by whether the change is good (churn up is red), and hairline dividers; wraps to two per row on narrow containers.
components.debug: Debug my stat strip. Rule out: deltas coloured by direction instead of meaning; proportional digits; more than five metrics fighting for attention. The symptom:

components.name: Media card
components.summary: Image cards locked to an aspect ratio so a grid of them always lines up.
called: blog post card with an image

anatomy.name: Media
anatomy.text: Cropped to a fixed ratio so a grid lines up.

anatomy.name: Meta
anatomy.text: Read time and date, tabular.

components.prompt: Add media cards: the whole card is one link, the image cropped with aspect-ratio and object-fit: cover, a 1.03 zoom on hover inside its frame, an eyebrow, a balanced title and a meta line.
components.debug: Debug my media cards. Rule out: images of different ratios breaking the grid; the zoom escaping its frame (overflow: hidden on the media); nested links inside the card. The symptom:

components.name: Avatar stack
components.summary: Overlapping initials with a +n counter for collaborators.

anatomy.name: Avatar
anatomy.text: Overlaps the next by 8px with a ring in the page colour.

anatomy.name: Overflow
anatomy.text: "and 3 more".

components.prompt: Add an avatar stack: a list with an aria-label of the total, overlapping circles with a 2px ring in the page colour, initials as fallback, and a "+n" item for the rest.
components.debug: Debug my avatar stack. Rule out: no accessible count; rings in a fixed colour that clash in dark mode; images without alt. The symptom:

components.name: Description list
components.summary: Clean key–value rows for settings and record details.
called: details panel with labels on the left

anatomy.name: Term
anatomy.text: Muted, left.

anatomy.name: Value
anatomy.text: Primary text; inline action links allowed.

components.prompt: Add a description list: a <dl> of term/value rows with hairline dividers, terms muted on the left, values on the right, stacking on narrow containers.
components.debug: Debug my description list. Rule out: divs instead of dt/dd; long values overflowing (overflow-wrap: anywhere); terms wrapping into two lines at common widths. The symptom:

components.name: Global filter bar
components.summary: One filter bar per dashboard: date range, removable chips, add and reset.
called: one filter bar for the whole dashboard

anatomy.name: Date range
anatomy.text: The filter people change most.

anatomy.name: Filter chip
anatomy.text: Click to remove.

anatomy.name: Reset
anatomy.text: Back to the defaults.

components.prompt: Add one global filter bar for a dashboard: a date-range segmented control, removable filter chips, an "Add filter" button and Reset, emitting one state object every card reads. Never repeat filter bars inside cards.
components.debug: Debug my filter bar. Rule out: cards with their own filters disagreeing with the global ones; chip remove buttons without names; focus lost after removing a chip. The symptom:

components.name: Chat thread
components.summary: Message bubbles grouped by sender, with read status, an attachment and a typing indicator.

anatomy.name: Outgoing bubble
anatomy.text: Accent fill on the right; the tail corner is only on the last bubble of a group.

anatomy.name: Group header
anatomy.text: Name and time once per group, not per message.

anatomy.name: Typing indicator
anatomy.text: Three dots for sight, "Riya is typing" for screen readers.

anatomy.name: Read status
anatomy.text: Only under your latest message.

components.prompt: Build a chat thread: an <ol role="log" aria-live="polite">, consecutive messages from one sender grouped with one avatar, name and <time>, incoming bubbles on a neutral surface and outgoing on the accent, small tail corners only where bubbles stack, a file attachment card, "Read 09:45" under the latest outgoing group, and a three-dot typing indicator with hidden text.
components.debug: Debug my chat thread. Rule out: every message repeating the avatar and time; long URLs breaking the bubble (overflow-wrap: anywhere); the log announcing old messages on load; accent bubbles with text below 4.5:1. The symptom:

components.name: Prompt composer
components.summary: A chat input that grows with its text, sends with ⌘↵ and keeps attach and mode within reach.
preview: Summarise churn by plan for Q4
called: message box at the bottom of a chat
text box with a send arrow

anatomy.name: Text area
anatomy.text: Grows to eight lines, then scrolls.

anatomy.name: Send
anatomy.text: The only filled button, so it is easy to find.

anatomy.name: Shortcut hint
anatomy.text: Enter makes a new line; ⌘↵ sends.

anatomy.name: Mode switch
anatomy.text: Small and secondary.

components.prompt: Add a prompt composer: a rounded form with a textarea that grows to eight lines (field-sizing: content with a JS fallback), a bar with an attach button, a small Ask/Edit radiogroup, a "⌘↵ to send" hint, a character count that warns near the limit and a round send button that is disabled until there is text. Enter adds a line; ⌘/Ctrl+Enter sends.
components.debug: Debug my composer. Rule out: Enter sending when people expect a new line (or the reverse, document whichever you pick); the textarea jumping height on every keystroke; send enabled for whitespace; the page scrolling when the textarea grows. The symptom:

components.name: Kanban board
components.summary: Cards in status columns you can drag, or move with Space and the arrow keys.
components.pattern: Drag and drop with keyboard alternative
called: columns of cards you drag between

anatomy.name: Card
anatomy.text: One tab stop for the board; arrows move between cards.

anatomy.name: Column count
anatomy.text: Updates as cards move.

anatomy.name: Tag
anatomy.text: Colour plus a word, never colour alone.

components.prompt: Add a kanban board: columns as <section> with a heading and a live count, cards as list items that are draggable with native drag and drop, plus a keyboard path: Space lifts a card, arrows move it between columns and within a column, Space drops, Esc cancels; announce every move in an assertive live region.
components.debug: Debug my kanban board. Rule out: drag and drop with no keyboard alternative; every card as its own tab stop; counts that do not update; layout reads inside dragover causing jank; the board forcing the page to scroll sideways on mobile (scroll the board instead). The symptom:

components.name: Before/after slider
components.summary: Two images stacked with a draggable divider; arrows move it too.
called: slider that wipes between two pictures

anatomy.name: Handle
anatomy.text: Shows where to grab; the real control is the range input.

anatomy.name: Labels
anatomy.text: Each side says what it is.

components.prompt: Add a before/after slider: two images stacked in a 16:9 frame, the top one clipped with clip-path: inset(0 0 0 var(--pos)), a round handle on a 2px divider, and a transparent full-size <input type="range"> on top so drag, touch and arrow keys all work. Label both images and show focus on the handle.
components.debug: Debug my before/after slider. Rule out: a custom pointer handler with no keyboard path; images of different sizes drifting apart (object-fit: cover on both); the range thumb invisible but still the hit target; no aria-valuetext. The symptom:
